fields.description:
Objective

Create a Partner record type on the Account object for affiliate/network partners. Deals with no external partner are associated to a dedicated Direct partner account so the Deal-to-Partner relationship is always populated.

Fields

  • Partner ID — Partner_ID__c — Auto Number, External ID, Unique

  • Partner Name — Name — Text(255), Required — duplicate prevention enforced

  • Partner Code — Partner_Code__c — Text(40) — short code parsed from raw/API values

  • Partner Type — Partner_Type__c — Picklist — Affiliate Network; Direct; Strategic Partner; Other Source

  • Active Status — Active_Status__c — Picklist — Active; Paused; Inactive; Review Required

Implementation Requirements

  • Create the Partner record type on Account with its own page layout

  • Create the fields listed above with help text per design doc story B-02

  • Create partner records: Catena Operations; GDC America; iRival Media; Sportsbook Insider; Dimers; Direct

Acceptance Criteria

  • Partner is a distinct Account record type with its own layout

  • Direct exists as a Partner account and as a Partner Type value

Testing Notes

Create the six partner records.

Out of Scope

Duplicate prevention rules (BUILD-08). Partner payout logic.

Open Questions

  • Should Direct be one shared partner account or one per operator? Sample data contains both patterns (Direct, OLG (Direct)). Build with the single shared account until the client says otherwise.

Additional Notes

  • Consider a shared global value set for Active Status across Operator/Partner (design doc recommendation).

Estimate: S · ~5h · Dependencies: POC-01 · Ticket POC-04 (approved 2026-07-04)
